steps.title: Pre-position for Swelling Frost
steps.rule: Stand 2m out from the centre on your own direction: Swelling Frost knocks you 10m straight out and freezes you, so this is where you land.

steps.title: Crystal positions
steps.rule: Tanks and melee: stand at the wall behind your Crystal of Light, 4m clockwise of it, so its Hiemal Storm puddles drop at the edge. Healers and ranged: stand just behind your Crystal of Darkness, so its Sinbound Blizzard cone points out at the wall and never reaches a Crystal of Light.

MainTank.rule: North wall, a step clockwise (east) of the north crystal.

MeleeDpsA.rule: East wall, a step clockwise (south) of the east crystal.

OffTank.rule: South wall, a step clockwise (west) of the south crystal.

MeleeDpsB.rule: West wall, a step clockwise (north) of the west crystal.

ShieldHealer.rule: Behind the north-east dark crystal, by waymark 2.

CasterDps.rule: Behind the south-east dark crystal, by waymark 3.

RegenHealer.rule: Behind the south-west dark crystal, by waymark 4.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Behind the north-west dark crystal, by waymark 1.

steps.title: Sidestep the Hiemal Storms
steps.rule: Each Hiemal Storm drops on the player nearest your Crystal of Light, which is you: as it starts, cross 8m along the wall to the other side of your crystal, first counter-clockwise, then back, until your crystal is destroyed. You also take your crystal's Hiemal Ray tether.

MainTank.rule: Alternate west and east of the north crystal.

MeleeDpsA.rule: Alternate north and south of the east crystal.

OffTank.rule: Alternate east and west of the south crystal.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Alternate south and north of the west crystal.

steps.title: Your crystal is down: move in
steps.cue: Your Crystal of Light is destroyed
steps.rule: Once your Crystal of Light falls, walk in to 7m on your cardinal, toward the Ice Veil.
